format.note: 10 clubs play each other four times (36 matches each). The season table also marks 1st-6th as a Championship round and 7th-10th as a Relegation round, but no second-phase round count exists in any source and the 21 Aug 2026 - 9 May 2027 calendar cannot hold one, so the split is not modelled.

playoff.note: 9th plays the loser of the Kategoria e Pare promotion play-off final for the last top-flight place; 10th is relegated directly.

format.note: double round-robin (rounds 1-22) plus a third meeting (rounds 23-33)

playoff.note: semi-finals and final over one match; the winner is promoted, the final loser then meets the Kategoria Superiore 9th. 11th and 12th are relegated, 9th and 10th play a relegation play-out.

boundaries.note: Two clubs go up directly and the play-off winner is the third. Down: 10th directly, 9th through a one-off against that play-off's final loser. The published movement does not balance (3 up, 2 down) because the 2026-27 top-flight format is mid-reform; no source names a third relegated club. | balanced to keep league sizes after a source conflict.

conflicts.real: 36 rounds plus announced Championship/Relegation rounds (top 6 / bottom 4)
conflicts.note: Both the English and Albanian 2026-27 articles mark the split and link to sections that do not exist; neither gives a round count for it. Treated as an announcement, not a format.

conflicts.real: 10th relegated directly, 9th plays the Kategoria e Pare play-off final loser
conflicts.note: The Albanian league overview still states the old rule (bottom two down, no play-out); the 2026-27 Kategoria e Pare article describes the play-off for 9th.

conflicts.real: 3 promoted (2 direct + 1 play-off) against 2 documented relegation places
conflicts.note: The two directions cannot both be true for a 10-club league; the missing place is not documented in any source read.

notes: Sizes and levels match our rows (10 and 12) and are solid for 2026-27. Kategoria Superiore: 36 matches each (four meetings) is stated by both wikis; the top-6/bottom-4 'Championship round'/'Relegation round' markers are not backed by any round structure and are not modelled. 2025-26 used a different relegation shape (8th in the play-off, 9th-10th down), so history seeded from last season will not match. Kategoria e Pare: 33 rounds (22+11), top two up, 3rd-6th play-off, 11th-12th down, 9th-10th play-out. Kategoria e Dyte (level 3) is outside our dataset.
